name: Amend / co-term line with correct partner band
expected: Amend line is eligible for the Manual Quote Level Discount path; co-term net carryover honored; for a new-business maintenance (Fortra_Product_Type='New Maintenance') line the NEW-BUSINESS partner band is applied, NOT the renewal-maintenance band. Concretely on the control account (model New_Maintenance_Percent=12, Renewal_Maintenance_Percent=10): a New-Maint Amend line nets a new-business value (71 x (1-newbiz%)), never the renewal value 71 x 0.90 = 63.90.
actual: Active proc V21 (status=Active, versionNumber=21; d01_v21_fresh.json). PROC TRACE: ManualQuoteLevelDiscount (step 85, AdvancedListFilter) filter logic '1 AND (2 OR 3 OR 4) AND (5 OR 6)' where criterion 2 = ItemSalesTransactionAction Equals 'Amend' => Amend lines ARE eligible. Dedicated AmendNetCarry group (steps 3-6, seq39): AmendFilter gates ItemPricingSource='LastTransaction' AND ItemSalesTransactionAction='Amend' AND DerivedPricingAttribute=false, then AmendSeedNetUnit = IF(NetUnitPrice>0,NetUnitPrice,InputUnitPrice) (co-term net carryover). Partner band keyed PURELY on Fortra_Product_Type__c (PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType: 'New Maintenance'->New_Maintenance_Percent__c, 'Renewal Maintenance'->Renewal_Maintenance_Percent__c); PartnerNetPricePosthook.isNewBusinessDerivedMaintenance returns true ONLY for productType='New Maintenance' AND non-renewal quote, so the Renewal-Maintenance/renewal-COLA band path is GATED OUT for a New-Maint amend line. REAL DATA (UI-priced control quote 0Q0WC0000039Vm10AE, Deal_Type='Channel Originated', partner 001WC00000ZtazZYAR, USD): New-Maint AMEND line 0QLWC000003ehR8 (PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK, FPT='New Maintenance' on QLI+Product2, QuoteAction.Type='Amend', Maintenance Type Defn=Standard rate 0.20, Source_List_Price=355, derived base 71). 3x Force-reprice (place isSuccess=true): UI-original Net=62.48 (=71x0.88, own New-Maint band 12%); converges and STABILIZES at Net=60.35 (=71x0.85, contributor-license carried Software band 15%) by pass 2-3. Renewal band (10% -> 63.90) NEVER applied at any pass. Sibling lines each resolve their OWN band: Subscription 77080 (18%), Perpetual 301.75 (Software 15%).

notes: Active proc Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 confirmed (fresh metadata status=Active, 123 steps). Three F-11 claims validated on a REAL UI-priced Amend line (not a hand-built headless line, so no base-seed gap): (1) Amend eligible for Manual Quote Level Discount = PASS by proc filter (ItemSalesTransactionAction='Amend' is criterion 2 of ManualQuoteLevelDiscount). (2) New-business band applied NOT renewal band = PASS empirically: the New-Maint amend line routes through isNewBusinessDerivedMaintenance (true) and the renewal-COLA/Renewal-Maintenance-band path is gated out; committed net (62.48 then stable 60.35) is always a new-business derivation, never the renewal 63.90. (3) Co-term carryover step (AmendNetCarry/AmendSeedNetUnit/Total) is present and structurally correct; not fully exercised on this perpetual-maintenance control (no subscription term/EndDate) -- same headless limitation noted in sibling A-02 (BLOCKED: couldn't build a hydrated native LastTransaction line via DML). DOCUMENTED NUANCE (NOT an F-11 defect, NOT the renewal band): on Force-reprice the committed net moves from the UI prehook's own New-Maint band (12% -> 62.48) to the SC-3412 posthook's contributor-carry band (15% -> 60.35) because buildDerivedMaintenanceSequentialDiscountUpdate carries the contributor (license) partner percent forward (the maint net is DERIVED from the license net). This is the deployed carry-forward design (project_newmaint_derivation_inconsistency / SC-3410 / SC-3412), same partner-posthook non-idempotency family as F-07 / SC-3359 -- a pre-existing observation, not the renewal-band misapplication this scenario guards against. defect_provenance SC-3346: the SC-3346 concern (a 'New Maintenance'-typed line on a RENEWAL quote wrongly selecting the New-Maint band) is the inverse case; here on a NON-renewal Amend the New-Maint/new-business band is the CORRECT outcome and the renewal band is correctly excluded. Read-only + Force-reprice only; no deploys/edits.
verdict_reason: On a real partner Amend quote, the New-Maintenance amend line is eligible for the Manual Quote Level Discount filter and is priced on the new-business derived-maintenance path with a new-business partner band (62.48 then stable 60.35), with the renewal-maintenance band (63.90) provably never applied -- exactly F-11's expected behavior.
